title: Waymo cars stranded on San Francisco streets as Fourth of July gridlock drains batteries

reading.body:
Autonomous vehicles are designed to operate under certain driving conditions, not to survive indefinitely in extreme congestion. When severe traffic gridlock trapped multiple Waymo vehicles near San Francisco after Fourth of July celebrations, their batteries drained faster than anticipated because the vehicles remained operational while stationary or moving very slowly for extended periods. The company attributes this to traffic conditions it did not foresee at the scale that occurred.

This is a failure of deployment planning rather than vehicle malfunction. The vehicles were sent into an area experiencing major road closures and unexpected congestion from a city event, conditions that fell outside normal operating parameters. It would have taken either advance warning from the city about the scale of disruption or a system for Waymo to monitor traffic conditions and restrict rides into affected zones.

Whether the vehicles' behavior during the fireworks themselves, or the fire incident, represented separate failures in perception or safety systems is not established by the reporting.

reports.title: Waymo cars stranded on San Francisco streets as Fourth of July gridlock drains batteries

summary:
Multiple Waymo autonomous vehicles had their batteries drain and required towing during severe traffic congestion in San Francisco following Fourth of July fireworks celebrations on Saturday. Video footage showed at least a dozen stationary Waymo vehicles, primarily Jaguar I-PACE models, lined up on streets near the Golden Gate Bridge after a city-sponsored fireworks display. The company attributed the incident to major traffic disruptions, high traveler volume, and unexpected road closures that created severe congestion in the area.

The situation highlighted challenges for autonomous vehicles during major events. One passenger reported the Waymo continued driving when fireworks were set off nearby, and a Waymo vehicle caught fire after driving over fireworks with no injuries reported. Frustrated motorists complained about the stranded vehicles blocking roads. The city's mayor and emergency management are now planning discussions with public and private partners to prevent similar problems at future events. Waymo stated it is evaluating ways to improve resilience during major traffic disruptions.
